description: Two story side extension; conversion of garage to habitable room with additional new front door; external alterations
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: normal;">Arboricultural Impact Assessment; 319-P001; 319-P01; 319-P02C; Flood Risk Assessment; Reasonable Exception Statement.</span>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>Prior to the commencement of development, revised plans shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority which will show the removal of the front door of the ground floor extension area, and revised window details. The development shall be carried out with the approved drawings and thereafter remain in perpetuity.&nbsp;<br></p><p><br></p>

<p>The proposed extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied or used at any time as a separate residential unit and shall remain in an ancillary use to the host dwellinghouse at No.11 Dorset Drive. Any other material change of use would require planning permission.</p>
